fact: The first official cricket Test match was played in 1877 between Australia and England at the Melbourne Cricket Ground. Australia won by 45 runs.
India won its first Cricket World Cup in 1983 under the captaincy of Kapil Dev.
Sachin Tendulkar is the first player to score 100 international centuries.
The FIFA World Cup was first held in 1930 in Uruguay.
Brazil has won the FIFA World Cup five times.
Lionel Messi led Argentina to the FIFA World Cup title in 2022.
The Thomas Cup is the world's premier men's team badminton championship.
India won its first Thomas Cup title in 2022.
A badminton match is played to 21 points in each game.
Wimbledon is the oldest tennis tournament in the world.
There are four Grand Slam tournaments in tennis.
Roger Federer won eight Wimbledon singles titles.
